verses.text: Brothers and sisters, about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
not to become unsettled or alarmed by a spirit, a message, or a letter supposedly from us claiming that the day of the Lord has already arrived.
Don't let anyone deceive you in any way. That day won't come until the rebellion happens and the lawless one—the one headed for destruction—is revealed.
He will oppose and exalt himself over everything called a god or worshiped, even setting himself up in God's temple and claiming to be God.
Don't you remember I told you this when I was with you?
You know what is holding him back for now, so he can be revealed at the right time.
The hidden power of lawlessness is already at work. The one holding it back will keep doing so until he is taken out of the way.
Then the lawless one will be revealed. The Lord Jesus will kill him with the breath of his mouth and destroy him by the splendor of his coming.
The lawless one's coming will follow Satan's activity, with all kinds of power, signs, and lying wonders,
and every kind of evil deception for those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and be saved.
For this reason, God lets a powerful delusion come over them, so they'll believe the lie
and be condemned—all those who refused to believe the truth and instead delighted in wrongdoing.

But we should always thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord. God chose you from the beginning to be saved through the Spirit's work of making you holy and through your belief in the truth.
He called you to this through our Good News, so you could share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold on to the teachings we passed on to you, whether in person or by letter.
May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and gave us lasting comfort and a good hope through grace,
encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and work.
